name: Area Agency on Aging, Region One
organization: Area Agency on Aging, Region One
description: The Area Agency on Aging for this county: the local door to meals, transportation, caregiver support, services at home and the local long-term-care ombudsman program.
next_step: Call with the county and what is hard right now. Ask for an assessment and the next referral. Military service is not required.
constraints: Many services focus on people age 60 and older or their caregivers; not all services are available in every region.

On the Navajo Nation, aging services are through the Navajo Nation Division of Aging and Long-Term Care Support (928-871-6869). Other tribal members can also ask the Inter Tribal Council of Arizona Area Agency on Aging, Region Eight (602-258-4822).
